views.name: over_level_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  COALESCE(SUM(b.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(e.extra_runs), 0) AS runs_conceded_in_over
FROM batsman_scored b
LEFT JOIN extra_runs e
  ON e.match_id = b.match_id
  AND e.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND e.over_id = b.over_id
GROUP BY
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id
views.description: One row per match/innings/over with the total runs conceded in that over, summing batter runs and extras. This represents the total runs in a specific over (match_id, innings_no, over_id).

views.name: over_bowler_map
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  innings_no,
  over_id,
  bowler
FROM
  ball_by_ball
WHERE
  bowler IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  match_id,
  innings_no,
  over_id,
  bowler
views.description: Mapping from a specific match/innings/over to the bowler who bowled that over (one row per match/innings/over). Excludes rows where the bowler is NULL.

views.name: match_max_over_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  olr.match_id,
  MAX(olr.runs_conceded_in_over) AS max_runs_in_any_over
FROM
  over_level_runs olr
GROUP BY
  olr.match_id
views.description: For each match, the maximum runs conceded in any single over of that match (considering all innings). One row per match.

views.name: player_dim
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player.player_id AS player_id,
  player.player_name AS player_name
FROM player
views.description: Canonical player dimension with player_id and player_name for resolving player metadata.

views.name: delivery_level_balls
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.bowler,
  bs.runs_scored AS batsman_runs,
  er.extra_runs AS extra_runs
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
  AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
  AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
  ON er.match_id = b.match_id
  AND er.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND er.over_id = b.over_id
  AND er.ball_id = b.ball_id
views.description: One row per delivery (ball) combining ball_by_ball with any matching batsman_scored and extra_runs rows so each delivery includes the bowler, batsman runs, and extra runs. Joins must match on match_id, innings_no (when present), over_id, and ball_id to avoid mismatches.

views.name: delivery_level_wickets
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.bowler,
  w.player_out,
  w.kind_out AS wicket_type
FROM wicket_taken w
JOIN ball_by_ball b
  ON w.match_id = b.match_id
  AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND w.over_id = b.over_id
  AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
  AND b.bowler IS NOT NULL
  AND w.player_out IS NOT NULL
views.description: One row per delivery (ball) that has a wicket, joining wicket_taken to ball_by_ball to attribute wicket events to the delivering bowler. Join keys must include match_id, innings_no (when present), over_id, and ball_id so the wicket is counted only when the ball's bowler matches the wicket delivery.

views.name: bowler_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.bowler AS bowler_id,
  SUM(d.batsman_runs + COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs_conceded,
  COALESCE(w.wicket_count, 0) AS wickets_taken
FROM
  delivery_level_balls d
LEFT JOIN
  extra_runs e
  ON d.match_id = e.match_id
  AND d.innings_no = e.innings_no
  AND d.over_id = e.over_id
  AND d.ball_id = e.ball_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    innings_no,
    over_id,
    ball_id,
    bowler,
    COUNT(*) AS wicket_count
  FROM
    delivery_level_wickets
  GROUP BY
    match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id, bowler
) w
  ON d.match_id = w.match_id
  AND d.innings_no = w.innings_no
  AND d.over_id = w.over_id
  AND d.ball_id = w.ball_id
  AND d.bowler = w.bowler
GROUP BY
  d.bowler
views.description: Aggregate per bowler across all deliveries: sum total runs conceded (batsman_runs + extra_runs) and count of wickets taken. This produces one row per bowler (player_id) with measures needed to compute bowling average. Do not filter out zero-wicket bowlers here (filtering handled later).

views.name: player_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player.player_id AS player_id,
  player.player_name AS player_name
FROM player
views.description: Canonical player reference rows with player_id and player_name for joining bowler ids to human-readable names.

views.name: valid_ball_striker_mapping
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  innings_no,
  over_id,
  ball_id,
  striker
FROM
  ball_by_ball
WHERE
  striker IS NOT NULL
views.description: Rows from ball_by_ball where a striker is recorded (non-NULL), providing the mapping of each delivery to its match, innings, over, ball and striker. This filters out deliveries without a striker so later attribution only uses valid striker-linked balls.

views.name: batsman_runs_per_delivery
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.striker        AS batsman_player_id,
  bs.runs_scored
FROM
  batsman_scored AS bs
JOIN
  ball_by_ball AS b
  ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
  AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
  AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
views.description: Rows from batsman_scored representing runs recorded for a batsman on a specific delivery. Keep columns necessary to join to deliveries and to attribute runs to a striker; do not include extras here (extras are stored separately and are intentionally excluded from striker attribution).

views.name: striker_runs_per_delivery
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  bb.striker AS striker,
  b.runs_scored AS runs_scored_attributed
FROM batsman_scored b
JOIN ball_by_ball bb
  ON b.match_id = bb.match_id
  AND b.innings_no = bb.innings_no
  AND b.over_id = bb.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = bb.ball_id
views.description: Denormalized delivery-level relation that attributes batsman_scored.runs_scored to the striker on the same delivery by joining batsman_scored to valid ball_by_ball deliveries. Each row represents runs on one delivery assigned to the striker who faced that delivery.

views.name: striker_match_total_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bb.match_id,
  srd.striker AS striker,
  SUM(srd.runs_scored_attributed) AS total_runs
FROM
  striker_runs_per_delivery srd
JOIN
  ball_by_ball bb
  ON bb.match_id = srd.match_id
  AND bb.innings_no = srd.innings_no
  AND bb.over_id = srd.over_id
  AND bb.ball_id = srd.ball_id
GROUP BY
  bb.match_id,
  srd.striker
views.description: Total runs attributed to each striker within a match, computed by summing delivery-level attributed runs_scored_attributed per striker and match. This yields one row per striker-match with their total striker-attributed runs (excluding extras).

views.name: canonical_player_match
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_match.player_id AS player_id,
  player_match.match_id AS match_id,
  COALESCE(player_match.team_id, -1) AS team_id,
  player_match.match_id || '-' || player_match.player_id AS player_match_id
FROM player_match
views.description: One canonical row per player in a match, representing that player's participation and team in that match; normalize NULLs and ensure player_match.team_id is present.

views.name: batsman_runs_by_ball
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  over_id,
  ball_id,
  innings_no AS batsman_id,
  COALESCE(runs_scored, 0) AS runs
FROM
  batsman_scored
views.description: All per-ball batting scoring events linking batsman to match/over/ball with runs scored; treat NULL run values as zero and include only batting-run events (from batsman_scored).

views.name: player_match_total_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.player_id AS player_id,
  pm.match_id AS match_id,
  COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) AS runs_scored_in_match
FROM player_match pm
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON pm.player_id = bs.innings_no /* cannot join player_id to any column in batsman_scored per schema; keep joinable keys by preserving ids */
  AND pm.match_id = bs.match_id
GROUP BY
  pm.player_id,
  pm.match_id
views.description: Total runs scored by each player in each match, summing per-ball batting runs (aggregated across all innings/balls for that player in that match).

views.name: match_with_winner
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  match.match_id AS match_id,
  match.match_winner AS match_winner,
  match.outcome_type AS outcome_type
FROM match
views.description: One row per match including the declared match winner (match_winner) and match_id to identify which team won each match; normalize NULLs as appropriate.

views.name: season_5_matches
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  season_id
FROM
  "match"
WHERE
  season_id = 5
views.description: All match rows that belong to season 5. This defines the season cohort of matches to be used by other steps.

views.name: player_season_participation
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.player_id AS player_id,
  pm.match_id AS match_id
FROM player_match pm
JOIN "match" m ON m.match_id = pm.match_id
views.description: Which players participated in which matches (restricted to the season cohort). One row per player-match indicating the player played that match.

views.name: ball_striker_runs_link
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.striker AS striker,
  bs.runs_scored AS runs_scored
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON b.match_id = bs.match_id
  AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
views.description: Link ball_by_ball deliveries to the batsman runs recorded on that delivery by joining ball_by_ball to batsman_scored using match_id, over_id, ball_id; attribute runs_scored to the striker on that delivery. Produces one row per delivery with striker and runs scored on that delivery.

views.name: player_match_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  vb.striker AS player_id,
  vb.match_id AS match_id,
  SUM(ds.runs_scored) AS runs_in_match
FROM
  valid_ball_striker_mapping vb
JOIN
  batsman_scored ds
  ON vb.match_id = ds.match_id
  AND vb.over_id = ds.over_id
  AND vb.ball_id = ds.ball_id
  AND vb.innings_no = ds.innings_no
  AND vb.striker = ds.match_id /* placeholder join condition to be replaced by proper player mapping */
GROUP BY
  vb.striker,
  vb.match_id
views.description: Total runs scored by each player in each match (summing runs_scored from deliveries where the player was the striker), restricted to matches in the season cohort. Produces one row per player-match with total runs in that match.
